unknown_option: module top;int v;covergroup cg;option.no_such_option=1;cp:coverpoint v;endgroup endmodule
bin_iff: module top;int v;covergroup cg;cp:coverpoint v{bins b={1} iff(v);}endgroup endmodule
bad_width: module top;bit[63:0] v;covergroup cg;cp:coverpoint v;endgroup endmodule
unknown_method: module top;bit v;covergroup cg;cp:coverpoint v;endgroup cg c;initial begin c=new();c.no_such_method();end endmodule
sample_value: module top;bit v;int i;covergroup cg;cp:coverpoint v;endgroup cg c;initial begin c=new();i=c.sample();end endmodule
duplicate_bin: module top;bit v;covergroup cg;cp:coverpoint v{bins b={0};bins b={1};}endgroup endmodule
close_label: module top;bit v;covergroup cg;cp:coverpoint v;endgroup:wrong endmodule
side_effect: module top;int v;covergroup cg;cp:coverpoint v++;endgroup endmodule
transition: module top;bit v;covergroup cg;cp:coverpoint v{bins b=(0=>1);}endgroup endmodule
wildcard: module top;bit v;covergroup cg;cp:coverpoint v{wildcard bins b={1};}endgroup endmodule
